provenance.E_c: Constant-guess rule approved on PR #3 (replaces v1 E_c = 0.30). One constant, 38.7015 C, = person-balanced mean +15-minute target over 175 development windows from the 11 people in no keep_going task; E_c = that constant's person-balanced MAE on the same windows, 0.1712 C. A forecast as bad as the constant guess on average earns zero forecast credit on average. Formula unchanged: max(0, 1 - err/E_c). Source: tasks/calibrate_forecast_e.py -> docs/forecast_e_calibration.json frozen_E_c.
provenance.ectemp_B: Per-person baseline MAE: tasks/beat_ectemp/ectemp_baseline.py (via template.py as submission.py) through benchmark.evaluate(hidden=True), person_mae over scored requests (3A: every request after the first watts drop; 3B: every request, approved 2026-11-07). Workbook MD5 01214bfc835215fe1a5d3f5da1e9ad52. Two hidden runs per variant with independent random time offsets gave identical values; the baseline never reads time_min. Only H06 and H13 ever drop watts, so 3A has 2 people (57 requests); 3B has all 5 test people (300 requests). 3B values recomputed for v3 (6 decimals); identical across two random time offsets.
provenance.required_cases: 12 scored keep_going cases (KG-03 edge case excluded), RB-01, RB-02, and 7 per-person Beat ECTemp cases (3A: H06, H13; 3B: all 5 test people).
